D: A sheltered Louisiana waterboy discovers he can tackle like nobody else and becomes a college football star.
P: Serve the drinks when Bobby hands out the water.
S: Golden cornmeal hush puppies with spring onion, fried crisp. Mix 200g cornmeal, 100g flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 1 egg, 250ml buttermilk and 2 spring onions.
Prawns tossed in Cajun spice and butter, cooked hot and fast. Toss 600g peeled prawns with 2 tsp Cajun spice and cook in 50g butter with 2 garlic cloves for 3 minutes.
M: Dark roux gumbo with chicken, smoked sausage and okra over rice, Louisiana home cooking. Cook 80g flour in 80ml oil to a dark roux.
W: Creamy Louisiana pecan pralines, set on baking paper. Boil 200g brown sugar, 100g caster sugar, 120ml cream and 40g butter to 115C.
K: Bobby's water, the best there is
Ice-cold spring water with lemon and cucumber, the high quality stuff.

s.how: Mix 200g cornmeal, 100g flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 1 egg, 250ml buttermilk and 2 spring onions. Fry spoonfuls at 180C for 3 minutes. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.
Toss 600g peeled prawns with 2 tsp Cajun spice and cook in 50g butter with 2 garlic cloves for 3 minutes. Serve with lemon. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

m.how: Cook 80g flour in 80ml oil to a dark roux. Add onion, celery and capsicum, then 600g chicken thigh, 300g smoked sausage, 1.2L stock and Cajun spice and simmer 1 hour. Add 200g okra for 10 minutes and serve over 300g rice.

w.how: Boil 200g brown sugar, 100g caster sugar, 120ml cream and 40g butter to 115C. Stir in 150g pecans and vanilla, beat until thick and spoon onto baking paper.

d.note: Bobby's water, the best there is
d.how: Fill a big jug with ice, 1.5L cold water, lemon slices and cucumber ribbons. Serve in tall glasses. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold.
